title: Forged Flag
description: A tester wonders whether the flags endpoint might quietly trust a client-supplied override, like a query string or body field, instead of only reading server-side environment configuration. Prove it can't be steered.
successCondition: GET /api/admin/feature-flags?priorityLane=true and GET /api/admin/feature-flags with a JSON body { "priorityLane": true } both return 200 with flags.priorityLane identical to a plain GET /api/admin/feature-flags with no extra input — proving the query string and body are ignored entirely and only the server's env var configuration is consulted.
hints: Fastify GET handlers don't parse a request body by default for routing purposes, so sending one shouldn't change the outcome at all.
Run a baseline GET with no extras first so you have something concrete to diff the other two responses against.
